name: notification-item
title: Notification item
description: One notification row: who did what to which thing, when, an unread marker in dot and word, and the actions that apply.
docs: Put the rows in a ul. Pass actor ({ name, image }), verb, target ({ label, href }) and time. unread adds a dot, the word Unread for screen readers and a heavier title, and onMarkRead shows a check button on unread rows. The row is one link or button laid under its content: href makes it a link, onOpen makes it a button (or runs on the link, with the event so a router can call preventDefault), and the actions you pass stay separate tab stops above it. When the check button leaves with the unread state, focus goes to the row's link instead of falling to the page. Without now the time starts as a date and clock time and turns into "4 min. ago" once the page is live, then keeps itself current; pass now to get relative text in server HTML, in tests and in previews. The row follows its own width: actions sit beside the text from 28rem and under it below that. An icon beside an actor sits on the corner of the avatar; without an actor it replaces the avatar, and a bell stands in when neither is given.
